items.note: User reported one third of a salad kit, possibly 'southeast' with avocado dressing; likely Southwest-style, but brand, exact kit and bag size are unknown and bag discarded. Photos inspected natively: lettuce/cabbage, crunchy strips and creamy dressing; no extras inferred from counter items. Higher-side comparable-kit proxy, not product identification: Taylor Farms Southwest Chopped Kit nutrition panel lists about 3.5 servings/bag, 100 g per serving, 150 kcal, 4 g protein, 9 g total carbs, 12 g fat, 2 g fiber, 2 g saturated fat, 170 mg sodium. One third bag = 3.5/3 servings (about 117 g as a proxy, not weighed), giving 175 kcal. Uses nutrition-panel 3.5 servings rather than conflicting FAQ's 3. The avocado-ranch comparator is 130 kcal x 3.5/3 = about 152 kcal; Southwest proxy is the higher-side match for crunchy strips. Included dressing and toppings assumed distributed proportionately: one third of each, not the entire dressing packet. No additional dressing or other foods logged. All nutrients estimated; no reuse of usual 330-calorie kit. Sources: https://www.taylorfarms.com/products/southwest-chopped-kit/ and https://www.taylorfarms.com/products/avocado-ranch-chopped-kit/ .
